name: Normal values: 1985-88 Fiero 2.8 V6 (L44, VIN 9, ECM 1227170)
about: Baseline readings used by the Analysis tab, the guided tests, the dashboard and Ask Claude. 'confidence' says how solid each figure is: gm = from a GM diagnostic chart or spec; gm_general = a GM figure for this generation of engines, not Fiero-specific; owners = consistent reports from Fiero owners; app = the app's own working estimate where no published figure was found.

tps_closed.label: Throttle (TPS), closed
tps_closed.condition: key on or idle, foot off
tps_closed.note: GM code 22 chart: a scan tool should read under 1.25 V with the throttle closed. Owners report 0.5-0.9 V. The 2.8 (VIN 9) TPS isn't adjustable.

tps_full.label: Throttle (TPS), wide open
tps_full.note: No published Fiero figure found. The reading should rise smoothly to near the 5 V reference.

map_koeo.label: MAP, key on engine off
map_koeo.condition: key on, engine off (reads the barometer)
map_koeo.note: A GM 1-bar MAP sensor reads about 4.5 V with the key on and engine off (lower at altitude); the ECM uses this as barometric pressure.

map_idle.label: MAP at warm idle
map_idle.note: Under 1.5 V at idle. Higher means less vacuum (vacuum leak, EGR open, late timing). Code 33 sets above about 4.0 V, code 34 below about 0.25 V.

iac_warm_idle.label: IAC at warm idle
iac_warm_idle.condition: warm idle in Park/Neutral, A/C off
iac_warm_idle.note: Owners report 20-40 (one Fiero thread: 30-35). Near 0 means too much air is getting in (vacuum leak, throttle). 80 or more means the idle is too low / not enough air.

rpm_warm_idle.label: Warm idle speed
rpm_warm_idle.note: Owners give about 900 rpm for the V6. The ECM sets it through the IAC; the throttle stop screw isn't the idle adjustment (base idle with the IAC fully closed is about 500 rpm).

blm.label: Long-term fuel trim (BLM)
blm.note: 128 = no correction. 118-138 is healthy for GM engines of this era. The stock V6 PROM limits BLM to about 120-150, so readings near those ends mean the ECM has run out of correction.

int.label: Short-term fuel trim (INT)
int.note: 128 = no correction; it moves quickly around 128 while BLM moves slowly.

o2.label: O2 sensor
o2.note: Reads a steady ~450 mV bias until hot, then switches between about 100 and 900 mV. Suspect if it stays below 300 mV or fixed above 800 mV.

o2_switch_rate.label: O2 switches per second
o2_switch_rate.note: No published normal found. A healthy sensor switches several times per second at 2000 rpm; the app treats under 0.7/s as lazy and under 0.3/s as failed.

coolant_warm.label: Coolant, warm
coolant_warm.note: The 2.8 uses a 195 F thermostat; the ECM turns the fan on around 235 F.

battery_koeo.label: Battery, engine off
battery_koeo.note: General lead-acid figure: about 12.6 V when fully charged; under 12.2 V is low.

fuel_pressure.label: Fuel pressure (gauge, not in the data stream)
fuel_pressure.condition: key on, engine off, pump running
fuel_pressure.note: Quoted from GM's spec by owners. About 36-40 psi at idle (the regulator lowers it with vacuum). Measure with a gauge on the fuel rail.

base_timing.label: Base ignition timing (timing light, not in the data stream)
base_timing.condition: set with the timing connector disconnected
